title: sos_origin: pin eviction-then-replay-with-lower-seq attack shape in a test
description: 3x codereview on fgmi doc fix (correctness non-finding observation, elevated to bead): the doc's security-critical 'previously-seen (including lower) sequences become acceptable again' is entailed by code but the test suite only pins reappearance with a HIGHER seq (tracker_bound_evicts_least_recently_accepted: a,11 after eviction of a@10). Add a regression test for the attack shape from chmr: fill gate to capacity, flood with distinct origins to evict victim, then replay a captured valid frame with lower seq — assert acceptance (documenting the vulnerability boundary) until chmr's mitigation lands.
